verdict: Multiple strong indicators suggest possible tampering on this GST certificate. The GSTIN check digit does not validate, the embedded PAN does not match the legal name, and localized visual anomalies appear over both the GSTIN and legal name fields.

findings.title: GSTIN check digit does not match
findings.plain_explanation: Indicators suggest the GSTIN number may have been altered because its final verification character does not match the official pattern.
findings.technical_detail: Mod-36 weighted checksum failed on GSTIN '27AAAPS1234P1Z9' (expected check digit 'K', found '9').

findings.title: Legal name does not match embedded tax ID
findings.plain_explanation: The proprietor name shown on the certificate does not match the initial encoded inside the GSTIN.
findings.technical_detail: PAN 5th character 'S' does not match surname initial 'M' of Legal Name 'Rajesh Mehta'.

findings.title: Possible text edit over key fields
findings.plain_explanation: Visual sharpness and background shading around the GSTIN and legal name differ from the rest of the page, suggesting a possible edit.
findings.technical_detail: text_patch detector flagged 2 outlier word regions (scores 0.88 and 0.82) on line background & Laplacian variance.
